lead:
The origin of cells, treated not as a single spark but as a staged sequence of nonequilibrium
transitions at an alkaline hydrothermal vent — each one a falsifiable step a simulation can pass or
fail. The guiding hypothesis is the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of life: that the vent–ocean
interface hands a nascent cell its first free-energy source (a natural proton gradient across thin
mineral walls), its first reduced carbon (H2-driven CO2 reduction), and a place to concentrate and
enclose that chemistry — before the cell evolves its own membranes, pumps and genes. The campaign
builds that vent from real geochemistry upward (serpentinization, reactive transport, H2-driven
carbon fixation, self-amplifying networks) and runs the classical favorable and the 2026 unfavorable
scenarios head to head rather than assuming either. Each stage is a coupled Vivarium composite of
genuine simulators (PHREEQC, FiPy, eQuilibrator, libRoadRunner — plus a merged FEniCS/dolfinx FEM
solver run under pixi as a high-fidelity cross-check) under explicit conservation contracts.
All seventeen member studies are built and run on real simulators. The fourteen-stage arc — from vent
geochemistry through carbon fixation, protometabolism, individuality, compartmentation, internalized
bioenergetics and heredity to ecology, escape, and the nitrogen/phosphorus/energy/growth bottlenecks —
plus the Phase-1 environmental-calibration study (og-cal-vent-environment) pass their pre-stated
falsifiable gates, with an adversarial vent-ablated control rejected by every discriminating gate. Two
Model-Upgrade calibration studies report honest results rather than passes: the Phase-2 electrochemistry
mechanism map (og-01-cal-electrochemistry) fails its cross-class agreement gate because the limitation
attribution is structure-sensitive, and the Phase-3 open-network study (og-02-alt-reaction-universe)
finds that no autocatalytic motif emerges at vent conditions without a one-carbon feed.

Before LUCA — population-level emergence vs single-lineage reconstruction
Leaving home — the minimum innovation set for an autonomous cell off-gradient
Adversarial control: the gates must reject generic non-vent chemistry
The first nitrogen — reduced-N keeps pace with carbon, or limits first
Phosphorus — can the pore co-concentrate P with C and N, or does it precipitate first?
Owning its energy currency — capturing geochemical free energy into a transferable store before modern pumps
Growth and division — metabolism changes the compartment's physical fate (grow->divide vs lyse vs starve)

question: Could the first cells have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents? Can a physically plausible early-Earth vent–ocean interface generate and sustain, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, self-amplifying chemistry, concentration, and compartments a protocell needs — without inserting metabolism, membranes, or heredity by assumption?
hypothesis: Under field- and lab-consistent parameter ranges, a serpentinization-fed, spatially resolved alkaline vent reproduces the conditions for a cellular origin: it crosses, in order, falsifiable thresholds for sustained carbon fixation, network persistence, concentration/individuality, compartmentation, internalized energy, and heritable organization — with identifiable parameter regions where each step fails.

executive.what_is_this: A staged, falsifiable Vivarium campaign testing the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of cells — treating a cellular origin as coupled transitions from geochemistry to bioenergetic autonomy, grounded in serpentinization-driven alkaline hydrothermal vents, with explicit competing scenarios.
executive.verdict: The full geochemistry-to-heredity arc runs and passes. All seventeen member studies execute on real simulators; the fourteen-stage arc and the Phase-1 calibration pass their pre-stated, falsifiable gates with conservation held to machine precision — a Lost City vent (og-00), H2-driven carbon fixation benchmarked against Preiner/Hudson with the Tutolo-2026 risk mapped (og-01), a self-amplifying rTCA network (og-02), thermophoretic individuality (og-03), amphiphile compartments (og-04), internalized bioenergetics bounded by the Sojo cost (og-05), heredity that need not presume RNA (og-06), metacommunity robustness (og-07), an irreducible escape set {pump, importer, heredity} (og-08), plus the nitrogen, phosphorus, energy-currency and growth/division bottleneck modules. A Phase-1 environmental-calibration study (og-cal) then re-runs og-00's vent under the campaign's new three-quantity standard — conditioning an LHS prior on the Lost City windows leaves a posterior in which 100% of the empirically supported distribution supplies what carbon fixation needs (6 of 48 prior draws reproduce all three Lost City windows, and all six meet og-01's requirements), the two transport-structure classes agree on viability, dissolved H2 is the single binding observation, and the conservation ledger is exact (0 of 96 points rejected). The Phase-2 electrochemistry mechanism map (og-01-cal-electrochemistry) is an honest NEGATIVE — the carbon_fixation face is built with real Butler–Volmer, empirical and (pixi-only) microkinetic classes and its charge/electron ledger closes on all 750 runs, but the pre-registered failure-mode-attribution gate FAILS (label agreement 0.47 < 0.8) because the limitation label is structure-sensitive (Butler–Volmer attributes the favorable region to the catalyst, the empirical class to its lumped gradient drive), with three decisions pending. The Phase-3 open chemical network (og-02-alt-reaction-universe) is likewise an honest result — a rule-generated C/H/O reaction universe (413 reactions, real eQuilibrator ΔG′) fed the Phase-1 posterior grows 0 autocatalytic motifs (every C–C route uphill at vent activities), while a formaldehyde feed grows exactly one, the formose cycle, enriched over matched nulls (p ≈ 0.04); the curated rTCA motif is reclassed as imposed and non-conserving. No autocatalysis emerges at vent conditions without a one-carbon feed — which sets Phase 4's question. Every step also has a mapped failure region, and the adversarial generic-nonequilibrium control passes by rejection — every discriminating gate rejects a vent-feature-ablated control while the vent passes — so the gates are falsifiable and vent-specific. What remains open is editorial (publication scope), architectural (folding the stages into one persistent world), and the forward Model-Upgrade program that re-grounds each stage under the feasibility/robustness/discrimination standard — its foundation being canonical vg_* schemas, model-class-as-a-sweep-axis, a vg-data provenance layer, a UQ layer and a conservation ledger — is built, Phase 1 (environmental calibration) is done, Phase 2 (electrochemical carbon fixation) is built and run as an honest negative (structure-sensitive attribution, decisions pending), Phase 3 (open chemical network) has run (no autocatalytic motif at vent conditions without a one-carbon feed), and Phase 4 (3-D multisolute localization) has run its co-localization map — finding that the prebiotic mixture fractionates rather than co-localizes in a single thermophoretic pore, a candidate incompatibility — with Phases 5–9 the planned path — not unrun science in the staged arc itself.
executive.verdict_detail: 17 member studies (Campaigns 0–VIII, four resource/energy bottleneck modules, an adversarial control, a Phase-1 environmental-calibration study, a Phase-2 electrochemistry mechanism map, and a Phase-3 open-network study) wired into a DAG — all run; all gate-passing except the Phase-2 map, whose agreement gate fails honestly (below). The Phase-3 study (og-02-alt-reaction-universe) passes its motifs-emerge-not-imposed gate as an honest result — 0 autocatalytic motifs on the Phase-1 feed, the formose cycle only on a formaldehyde feed (enriched over matched nulls, p ≈ 0.04). Each runs a coupled Vivarium composite of real tools (PHREEQC + FiPy; eQuilibrator + FiPy; libRoadRunner; a FiPy thermal trap; amphiphile self-assembly; bioenergetic internalization; an agent-based heredity lineage; a pore metacommunity; an osmotic growth/division compartment; a Butler–Volmer galvanic cell) and is graded on its conservation and acceptance gates. Headline results carry numbers — og-00 holds the Lost City window (T 40–91 °C, pH 9.0–10.8, positive H2 flux) over ~80% of the swept grid with |charge|=0; og-01 reproduces the Preiner/Hudson yields and shows the Tutolo arm halve the usable proton-motive gradient (427→43 mV); og-02 reaches a peak autocatalytic gain ~29.5 (settling lower as CO2 limits); og-06's compositional/hybrid heredity is seed-robust (0.878±0.005, 5/5 graded seeds, 8/8 in a wider sweep); og-08's escape set is irreducible (full set survives 1.0, any single knockout 0); og-cal's Lost-City-conditioned posterior is 12.5% of the prior yet 100% viable for downstream carbon fixation and transport-class-independent, with the conservation ledger exact (0/96 points rejected); og-01-cal-electrochemistry builds the vent wall as a Butler–Volmer galvanic cell sitting in the Altair-2025 current window (7 of 8 pre-registered gates pass, charge/electron ledger exact on 750 runs) but its failure-mode-attribution gate fails at label agreement 0.47 — a structure-sensitive limitation attribution reported as the Phase-2 mechanism map. The adversarial control is rejected by all five discriminating gates (min margin 1.8 decades) while the vent passes all five.
decisions_resolved: Baseline parameterization: run BOTH arms — classical favorable (Russell/Lane/Sojo) and the 2026 unfavorable reassessment (Tutolo/Jackson) — so the campaign adjudicates rather than assumes. Implemented in og-01.

Primary geochemistry engine: real PHREEQC (phreeqpython + vendored llnl.dat), which fields the Lost City pH endmember once peridotite (not dunite) is reacted. Reaktoro was conda-only and off the uv path.
Build order: geochemistry + transport first (og-00/og-01), then the reaction network (og-02) — not a thin end-to-end skeleton. This put a real composite in the workbench at stage 0.

Heredity strategy for og-06: compare all modules without presuming RNA. og-06's agent-based lineage grades RNA-like template, compositional (GARD), a template-focused hybrid and a non-heritable control head-to-head; compositional and hybrid heredity persist length-independently (functional persistence ~0.88, seed-robust 5/5 graded seeds) where a long low-fidelity template suffers the Eigen length catastrophe — so heredity need NOT presume a long high-fidelity RNA template.

Explicit electrochemistry for og-01 (Model Upgrade Phase 2): BUILT, not kept as the gradient-efficiency abstraction — the carbon_fixation face adds a real Butler-Volmer galvanic-cell class (Nernst half-cells, Koutecky-Levich transport limits, Preiner electron branching), with MineralConductivityProcess deriving gradient_efficiency from the wall circuit and a ChargeLedger auditing the Kirchhoff/faradaic residuals. The empirical gradient-efficiency class is kept as og-01's graded default.

Phase 2 attribution + default class (resolved by Eran): ACCEPT the structure-sensitive limitation attribution AS the Phase-2 result — the empirical and Butler-Volmer classes disagreeing on the limitation label in the favorable region (agreement 0.47 < 0.8) IS the finding, reported as the og-01-cal-electrochemistry mechanism map with gate_status failed (an honest negative); the gate is not re-tuned to force a pass. KEEP empirical as og-01's graded/headline default and butler_volmer as the registered high-fidelity electrochemistry class (the same FiPy-grades / FEniCS-cross-checks pattern), revisiting butler_volmer as the headline once Altair per-condition data turns its calibration window into a fit.

Phase 2 follow-up (accepted, not done): attach the Altair-2025 per-condition current / product time courses (turning the calibration window into a likelihood) and bridge CatMAP/Cantera to run the microkinetic carbon_fixation class under pixi, then re-run the mechanism map with three classes. Deferred because the per-condition dataset is not yet in-workspace and the microkinetic backend needs a pixi env.

og-03 retention gate (resolved by Eran): RESTATE it at the resolvable Peclet rather than the >=1e6 enrichment fold — the extreme fold is the closed-cell/reduced-model FiPy exp(Pe) figure the resolved FEM does not confirm above Pe ~ 13, so localization is gated on the Peclet, not the fold-magnitude. executive.architecture_thesis: Do not start with a cell. The campaign builds a geological world (environment, minerals, molecules, energy) in which increasingly biological organization must EMERGE, and the Process Bigraph itself changes shape as it does: localization creates persistent chemical regions; boundary formation creates a protocell composite around localized chemistry; growth and division rewrite one individual into two daughters with stochastic partitioning; sustained negative energy balance dissolves an individual back into the environment; an inheritance process is attached to an individual only when precursor availability, copying chemistry and fidelity support it. The same environmental world persists across all stages — new processes and bounded agents are added by structural transition, never by replacing the earlier model. Shared canonical biological schemas (environment, minerals, molecules, energy, boundary, individual, heredity, lineage/ecology) make every model class substitutable behind one interface, so swapping a model while holding the world constant becomes an experiment that separates parameter uncertainty from model-structure uncertainty. Endpoint: cells arise when processes previously distributed across the environment become composed inside a persistent, reproducing, heritable boundary.

scientific_argument.main_claim: Cells could have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents. In simulation on real geochemical and chemical engines, a serpentinization-fed vent–ocean interface supplies — in order — the free energy, reduced carbon, self-amplifying chemistry, concentration, compartmentation, internalized bioenergetics and heritable organization a protocell needs, each as an independently falsifiable nonequilibrium transition. The full arc passes its pre-stated gates, every step has a mapped parameter region where it fails, and an adversarial vent-ablated control is rejected by every discriminating gate — so the campaign adjudicates the vent mechanism rather than illustrating one story.
evidence_for: H2-dependent mineral-catalyzed CO2 fixation (Preiner, Varma, Huber)
pH-gradient-driven CO2 reduction with isotope controls (Hudson, Altair)
thermophoretic concentration in pores (Baaske, Mast & Braun)
evidence_against: in-situ pH/sulfur/longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume (Tutolo 2026; Jackson 2016)
no validated vent pathway spans to open-ended heredity (Module J)
lab yields are not Hadean environmental concentrations

the chemically-necessary prebiotic mixture fractionates rather than co-localizing in a single thermophoretic pore (Phase-4 co-localization map; surrogate and dolfinx FEM agree on both verdict and degree after the reconciliation) — the fractionation is SORET-DRIVEN — low-S_T species such as ammonium lag the strongly-thermophoretic ones (adsorption is kinetically negligible over the transit), a candidate spatial incompatibility for assembling the set a protocell needs together
caveats: Every quantitative anchor is laboratory or field provenance, not a measured Hadean environmental concentration — the campaign tests whether each mechanism is feasible and where it fails, not that these exact values held on the early Earth.

A few headline magnitudes are solver-sensitive extrapolations, not resolved results — notably og-03's enrichment fold (the reduced FiPy accumulation column reaches ~10⁸-fold, 9.6×10⁷, at accumulation Péclet ≈ 18, where it diverges ~5.6 decades from the resolved FEniCS/dolfinx field above the Pe ≈ 13 the FEM resolves); the defensible claim there is that localization occurs and is bounded, not the exact fold-magnitude. The resolved 3-D flow-through FEM solve (Phase 4) shows single-pore enrichment is strongest at low Péclet and washes out as flow rises (1/(1+Pe/pe0)), so that extreme fold belongs to the convection-enhanced closed-cell (recirculating) regime, distinct from the resolved flow-through result.

The chemically-necessary prebiotic MIXTURE does not all concentrate in the same place — the Phase-4 co-localization map finds the eight-solute mixture FRACTIONATES in a single thermophoretic pore, SORET-DRIVEN — the strongly-thermophoretic species concentrate while low-S_T species such as ammonium lag, holding the co-localization index low in the strong-Soret regime (~0.18, rising toward ~1 where the Soret contrast is weak). Adsorption is kinetically negligible over the pore transit (FEM mobile fraction 0.93–1.0), so it is not the cause. After the surrogate↔FEM reconciliation the surrogate and dolfinx FEM agree on both verdict and degree (within ~2–19%; coloc_index 0.176 vs 0.171 at Pe=1/×8). Reported as a candidate incompatibility, not a passed gate — concentration of one tracer is not concentration of the set a protocell needs together.

The stages currently run as separate composites with hand-carried parameters and a division counter rather than one persistent world whose bigraph restructures; until the Full Modeling Plan architecture lands (references/full-modeling-plan-integration.md), "a boundary forms" and "an individual divides" are scalar readouts, not changes in the composition itself.
scientific_argument.emergence_criterion: A passing stage must show organization that was NOT inserted by assumption: no cell object exists at the start of a run; individuals appear only when localized chemistry crosses assembly criteria (a structural rewrite that adds a protocell composite); they reproduce only by a division rewrite with conserved partitioning; they disappear by an extinction rewrite that returns their matter to the environment; and heredity is attached only when the chemistry supports it. Matter, charge and free energy are accounted across every such rewrite.
scientific_argument.model_structure_vs_parameters: Every interface (environment, carbon_fixation, proto_metabolism, localization, boundary, heredity) admits alternative model classes behind one canonical face. A stage's gates are run against each class on identical parameter axes; the region where all classes agree is the parameter-robust claim, the region where they disagree is model-structure uncertainty, reported separately. Competing origin scenarios (deep alkaline vent, shallow vent, terrestrial geothermal, generic nonequilibrium control) enter as substitutions on the environment interface, so the adversarial control generalizes to every stage.
scientific_argument.endpoint: Cells arise when processes previously distributed across the environment become composed inside a persistent, reproducing, heritable boundary — a biological transition that is also a change in the Process Bigraph itself.

key_claims.claim: Alkaline hydrothermal vents sustain a natural proton gradient across thin inorganic (Fe/Ni-sulfide) walls — a geologically free energy source a nascent cell could tap before evolving its own membrane and pumps.
Serpentinization of olivine delivers a sustained supply of H2, the reducing power that drives prebiotic chemistry at the vent.
That H2 reduces CO2 to organic carbon on native-metal and mineral catalysts without enzymes, reproducing the acetyl-CoA–like chemistry thought ancestral to life.
Nonenzymatic reaction networks (reductive-TCA fragments) can persist and self-amplify under continuous vent flow, a precursor to metabolism.
Thermal gradients in vent pores concentrate molecules by thermophoresis — a route to localized, individual-like accumulations against dilution.
Fatty-acid vesicles can assemble and persist under vent-like temperature and pH, giving the chemistry a compartment.
The classical favorable picture is contested — in-situ pH, sulfide availability and vent longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume, so each step is run against that challenge.

studies.name: og-00-vent-reactor-baseline
studies.title: The Serpentinizing Vent
studies.question: Can a Lost City–like, serpentinization-fed vent–ocean interface reproduce observed fluid mixing, heat transport, mineral precipitation and H2/alkalinity delivery under field-constrained conditions — with no origin-of-life claim?
proposed_mechanisms: A: serpentinization as boundary flux
B: flow/mixing/precipitation, evolving porosity

contract.note: bigraph-schema typed ports (_type/_units/bounds) + conservation predicates; the composite built for this study must declare a ProcessContract matching this face (audited via the workbench §Contract panel).

resolved_uncertainties: The Lost City high-pH endmember is the peridotite Ca-OH buffer (not the olivine brucite buffer).
Habitability is a bounded region (~80% of the olivine-rate × flow-velocity grid), not a single tuned point — the baseline sits inside it.

The habitability result is solver-robust — a FiPy↔FEniCS (dolfinx) head-to-head cross-check of the same spatial-transport face agrees on the vent (outlet T within 0.30%, identical pH, flux conserved ~1e-15), so the finding does not depend on the FiPy solver.
remaining_uncertainties: Sensitivity to the olivine/pyroxene ratio and to seawater-mixing dilution of the endmember.
The physical fate of the 12 flow-extreme points that exceed PHREEQC's 0–100 °C validity (currently FAIL by convention).

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Sweep pyroxene_fraction and mixing dilution to bound the pH endmember.

findings.statement: Outlet settles at 50.6 °C and pH 9.37 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).
findings.explanation: Real PHREEQC peridotite serpentinization (Ca-OH endmember) + FiPy transport; pH is a genuine speciation result, not tuned.

findings.statement: Serpentinization delivers a sustained H2 reducing-power flux (min 2.75e-4 mol/s over the back half of the run).

evidence.observed: 2.75e-4 mol/s

findings.statement: PHREEQC charge balance is conserved exactly (|charge|=0) and the FiPy FVM spatial-flux divergence is held to 4.9e-5 — within the 1e-3 contract tolerance (not machine epsilon).

evidence.observed: |charge|=0, |flux residual|=4.9e-5 (within 1e-3 tol)

findings.statement: The Lost City pH endmember required reacting PERIDOTITE (olivine+pyroxene), not dunite — Ca released once Mg is consumed buffers the fluid to pH ~9.5.
findings.explanation: Olivine-only buffers at ~7.8 (brucite); adding diopside gives the Ca-OH endmember that reproduces field pH.

findings.statement: The vent wall convects. Solving Darcy–Boussinesq porous flow (a stream-function Poisson ∇²ψ = −buoyancy·∂T/∂x on the real FiPy mesh) gives a buoyant recirculation cell — the hot alkaline conduit rises, the cold ocean sinks, convective velocities ~5× the background upflow (Peclet ~8) — rather than a prescribed uniform upflow. The recirculation mixes cold ocean inward, settling the outlet ~8 °C cooler (59 → 51 °C) while staying inside the Lost City window; flux conservation is preserved within the solver tolerance (flux residual ~5e-5, within the 1e-3 bound).

evidence.observed: recirculation cell (cold-left sinks, hot-right rises); vmax ~5× background; outlet 50.6 °C

findings.explanation: FipyReactiveTransportProcess now solves the stream function each step and advects T + solute with the divergence-free Darcy velocity (u=∂ψ/∂y, v=−∂ψ/∂x + upflow); ψ contours are the streamlines the cross-section viz overlays. buoyancy=0 recovers the old constant upflow.

findings.statement: Habitability is a bounded REGION of the (olivine reaction rate × flow velocity) operating space, not one tuned run — the real PHREEQC + FiPy vent settles inside the Lost City window (T 40–91 °C AND pH 9.0–10.8 AND H2>0) over ~80% of the swept grid (115/144 points). The FAIL regions are a cold-washout band at the fastest flow (17 cold points) and 12 points at the flow extreme that fall outside PHREEQC's 0–100 °C validity (recorded NaN → FAIL); the baseline operating point sits safely inside the window.

evidence.observed: 115/144 (80%) habitable over (olivine_rate 0.005–0.4 × flow_velocity 2e-4–3e-2); 17 cold-washout FAILs, 12 out-of-range NaN; baseline (★) in-window at 50.6 °C / pH 9.37

findings.explanation: The vent_habitability_phase_map sweeps the real serpentinizing reactor and reduces each point to the habitability PASS flag (settled outlet in-window with a positive H2 flux); rendered as the Lost City habitability map (Decision view). Enough serpentinization to drive H2 + alkalinity and slow enough flow to hold 40–91 °C / pH 9.0–10.8 bounds the habitable band.
findings.next_action: Sweep pyroxene_fraction (ol/px ratio) and seawater-mixing dilution to bound the pH endmember (og-00b).

studies.claim: Habitability is a bounded REGION of the operating space, not a single tuned run: across the (olivine reaction rate × flow velocity) grid the real PHREEQC + FiPy serpentinizing vent settles inside the Lost City window — T 40–91 °C AND pH 9.0–10.8 AND a positive H2 flux — over ~80% of the swept grid, and the baseline operating point sits safely inside it (T 50.6 °C, pH 9.37) with sustained H2, exact charge balance (|charge|=0) and FiPy flux divergence within the contract tolerance (4.9e-5 vs the 1e-3 bound).

biological_validation.basis: No origin-of-life claim at this stage — this is a geochemical/spatial testbed only.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real speciation reproduces the field T/pH window AND reveals the peridotite Ca-OH endmember requirement — a mechanistic gain over the tuned box.

derived.insight: Outlet settles at 50.6 °C and pH 9.37 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).

studies.question: Which combinations of T, pH, pressure, H2, CO2 and mineralogy generate sustained net organic-carbon flux across the interface — reproducing Hudson/Preiner/Altair regimes before any extrapolation?
proposed_mechanisms: C: pH-gradient electrochemistry

contract.note: bigraph-schema typed ports (_type/_units/bounds) + conservation predicates; the composite built for this study must declare a ProcessContract matching this face (audited via the workbench §Contract panel).

resolved_uncertainties: A viable favorable regime exists; formate strictly requires the pH gradient + H2 + catalyst.

The (vent pH × H2) fixation landscape is now mapped (14×14 sweep, open-flow sustained throughput), not inferred from a single run — the favorable region is broadly productive and scales with both the gradient and H2.
remaining_uncertainties: The continuous gradient_efficiency threshold between the favorable and Tutolo-collapse regimes (the phase map shows two levels; a third axis would resolve the boundary).

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Extend the phase map with T and pressure facets and a continuous gradient_efficiency axis to locate the viable-fixation boundary.

findings.statement: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

evidence.observed: formate=200 mM, acetate=100 µM, pyruvate=10 µM

findings.explanation: Real eQuilibrator ΔG'-gated, lab-calibrated mineral kinetics over the pH gradient.

findings.statement: Formate is present with the pH-gradient proton-motive force and collapses to <1 mM in every control (no gradient / no H2 / no catalyst).

evidence.observed: favorable 200 mM; all controls <1 mM

findings.statement: The Tutolo-2026 in-situ arm collapses the usable proton-motive gradient (pmf 427 → 43 mV), the discriminating test the campaign must survive.

evidence.observed: favorable pmf 427 mV vs Tutolo 43 mV

findings.explanation: Real FiPy Nernst-Planck electrodiffusion with a gradient_efficiency knob (1.0 favorable, 0.1 Tutolo).

findings.statement: Real eQuilibrator ΔG' is logged every step and makes feasibility explicit (fixation stops where ΔG' ≥ 0 — genuine product inhibition).

Carbon fixation SPENDS the proton gradient — a conserved proton budget (≈2 H⁺ per carbon) draws the loaded pmf down ~40% below the open-circuit 427 mV under load, then relaxes as products saturate. The gradient does work and is consumed, not merely correlated with reduction.

evidence.observed: pmf open-circuit 427 mV sags to ~250 mV (charge 0.60) at peak fixation, recovers to 427 mV

findings.explanation: A ProtonBudgetProcess integrates reservoir = supply − protons_per_carbon·carbon_flux − leak·reservoir; fixation reads the loaded pmf = pmf_open·(reservoir/capacity), closing the respiratory-control feedback.

findings.statement: A parameter sweep over the (vent pH × dissolved H₂) plane maps the carbon-fixation landscape, not a single run. In the open-flow reactor, sustained reduced-carbon throughput scales with both the pH gradient and H₂ (6.4 → 24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s; steady pool 7–28 mM); the Tutolo-2026 gradient collapse roughly halves it on the same axes, and the no-gradient / no-catalyst / no-H₂ controls zero it. The favorable region is broadly productive — the sharp dependence is on a SUSTAINED gradient, not on sitting at one pH/H₂ point.

evidence.observed: favorable 6.4–24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s vs Tutolo 2.2–15; controls 0

findings.explanation: 14×14 sweep of the real open-flow composite (pH 7–11 × H₂ 0.1–20 mM, exponential washout) reduced to sustained throughput per point; rendered as the carbon-fixation phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_phase_grid.py.

studies.claim: H2-driven CO2 reduction over Fe/Ni/S reproduces the Preiner/Hudson lab yields and net organic-carbon flux in a bounded favorable regime; the Tutolo-2026 arm shows the usable proton-motive gradient collapses at in-situ T/P (427 -> 43 mV), roughly halving the sustained flux; only the no-gradient / no-H2 / no-catalyst controls zero it.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Preiner/Hudson organic-carbon benchmarks with the controls behaving correctly.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real thermodynamics (eQuilibrator) + electrochemistry (FiPy NPP) explain both the favorable regime and the Tutolo collapse.

derived.insight: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

LUCA boundary condition
proposed_models_methods: Vivarium multi-agent composites over shared spatial fields

conditions.name: reproducibility
conditions.expr: solver and db and seed and scenario recorded

contract.note: bigraph-schema typed ports (_type/_units/bounds) + conservation predicates; the composite built for this study must declare a ProcessContract matching this face (audited via the workbench §Contract panel).

resolved_uncertainties: Connected, heterogeneous populations develop functional redundancy (robustness) that isolated compartments do not — robustly across seeds.

That robustness is an emergent property of a bounded region of the swept phase maps — needing diversity AND exchange, and collapsing under parasite load (the three-view Decision map over exchange_rate x parasite_load) — not a monotone response to any one knob.

Carry the robust metacommunity into the escape-from-the-vent transition (dispersal to a fluctuating environment).

findings.statement: A connected metacommunity of 8 pore compartments, each carrying a sparse coarse-grained protometabolic capability vector (2 of 12 functions intrinsic), develops functional redundancy (robustness 0.667) through cross-feeding and horizontal transfer, well above the isolated counterfactual (0.500) run on the identical seeded assignment. Across an 8-seed sweep the connected arm (0.71±0.08) strictly beats the isolated arm (0.42±0.06) on every seed (min gain 0.17), so the redundancy is a product of connectivity, not of the capability assignment.

findings.explanation: Coarse-grained deterministic metacommunity (reproduction, not wrapped ALife). Cross-feeding (a compartment expressing a capability its neighbour lacks supplies the byproduct) and horizontal transfer (the capability is copied from a donor) spread sparse intrinsic capabilities into redundant coverage across the ring; a capability held by >= 2 compartments survives a single-compartment loss. Acquired capability decays toward the intrinsic set, so it persists only while continuously supplied.

findings.statement: Robustness EMERGES only in a bounded corner of (cross-feeding exchange_rate x inter-compartment diversity). At low diversity the compartments are near-identical, so cross-feeding/HGT have nothing to share and robustness stays at the sparse intrinsic floor (~0.17-0.25 regardless of exchange); at low exchange a diverse-but-disconnected set holds a broad repertoire fragilely (each capability in one compartment, ~0.33-0.42); only where diversity >= ~0.4 AND exchange crosses ~0.2 does robustness climb to 0.58-0.83. The transition is a phase boundary, not a monotone response to either knob alone. The companion three-view Decision map over (exchange_rate x parasite_load) at the canonical diversity sharpens this — robustness clears the 0.5 emergence boundary only once exchange crosses ~0.2 AND parasite load stays low (0.667 at the parasite-free operating point), collapsing toward 0 as parasites drain their neighbours.

findings.explanation: Cross-feeding scales as exchange_rate/connectivity and is deficit-driven (zero between identical compartments), so diversity is the raw material and exchange is the spreading mechanism; both are necessary. The sparse capability space (2 of 12 intrinsic per compartment) makes an isolated compartment functionally fragile, so redundancy must be BUILT by the metacommunity.

findings.statement: The metacommunity's collective capability repertoire overlaps the Weiss-2016 anaerobic H2/CO2/FeS LUCA core at 0.60 (canonical) and 0.70±0.14 across seeds. This is reported as a far-end BOUNDARY the emergent set approaches from below — a phylogenomic constraint on capabilities eventually acquired — and is explicitly NOT a fitting target; the model is never tuned toward it.

evidence.observed: collective LUCA-core overlap 0.60 canonical, 0.70±0.14 across 8 seeds (reported, not gated)

findings.explanation: The LUCA reconstruction (anaerobic, H2-dependent, CO2-fixing, FeS-rich; Weiss 2016, 355 protein families; Moody 2024, LUCA embedded in an ecosystem ~4.2 Ga) is a constraint on which capabilities the lineage eventually acquired, used as a boundary condition on the emergent repertoire rather than as evidence the first compartments were LUCA-like.

studies.claim: A connected metacommunity of heterogeneous pore compartments develops functional redundancy (robustness) that an isolated compartment cannot — cross-feeding and horizontal transfer spread coarse-grained protometabolic capabilities into >= 2-fold coverage, so most functions survive a single-compartment loss. biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the ecological expectation that connected, heterogeneous populations are more robust than isolated compartments (functional redundancy via cross-feeding + horizontal transfer), with the anaerobic LUCA reconstruction as a far-end boundary rather than an assumption.

explanatory_gain.basis: Identifies robustness as an EMERGENT property bounded in (diversity x exchange) space — a phase boundary, not a monotone response — and frames the LUCA overlap as a reported constraint, separating "capabilities eventually acquired" from "the first compartments were LUCA-like".

derived.insight: A connected metacommunity of 8 pore compartments, each carrying a sparse coarse-grained protometabolic capability vector (2 of 12 functions intrinsic), develops functional redundancy (robustness 0.667) through cross-feeding and horizontal transfer, well above the isolated counterfactual (0.500) run on the identical seeded assignment. Across an 8-seed sweep the connected arm (0.71±0.08) strictly beats the isolated arm (0.42±0.06) on every seed (min gain 0.17), so the redundancy is a product of connectivity, not of the capability assignment.

studies.name: og-adv-generic-nonequilibrium

studies.question: Does a generic nonequilibrium chemical system with no vent-specific features (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface, no pore concentration) pass the vent-specific gates? It SHOULD NOT.
proposed_mechanisms: the same real og-01/02/03 composites with vent features (H2, Fe/Ni/S catalyst, pore concentration) disabled
proposed_models_methods: flat gradient, inert surface, open pore, well-mixed — a generic abiotic nonequilibrium mixture

findings.statement: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. The vent passes all five.

evidence.observed: min rejection margin 1.84 decades (tightest gate: og-03 accumulation Péclet, generic 0.26 < 18); all 5 gates reject generic, vent passes all 5

findings.explanation: The vent features are PARAMETERS on the same real composites, so the control is a parameterization of the vent models, not a hand-tuned mock. No dissolved H2 → no CO2 reduction; no Fe/Ni/S interface → no abiotic carbon fixation; an open pore → no thermophoretic concentration.

findings.statement: The gates are vent-specific detectors, not generic nonequilibrium detectors — the vent passes where the control fails on each of the five gates. A PASS therefore certifies the vent mechanism (sustained H2 + Fe/Ni/S catalysis + pore concentration), falsifying the "the gates just measure any driven chemistry" objection.

evidence.observed: vent passes 5/5 gates; generic control fails 5/5 — pass-where-control-fails on every gate

findings.explanation: Same gotcha as og-04's mix_fraction=0; a control parameter set to exactly 0.0 must be clamped to a negligible floor so the ablation is real.

Are there local windows where reactive P is produced faster than it is lost?
proposed_mechanisms: I: limiting-resource phosphorus speciation
F: transport/concentration/retention (og-03 pore coupling)
proposed_models_methods: og-03 FiPy thermophoretic trap as the enrichment coupling

conditions.name: nonnegative_pools
conditions.expr: phosphate >= 0 and polyphosphate >= 0 and reactive_P >= 0 and mineral_P >= 0

conditions.name: reproducibility
conditions.expr: solver and db and seed and scenario recorded

evidence.observed: ~+1.8e-6 mol/s net availability; reactive P ~94% of supply; ~6% precipitated

findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner ODE P-speciation network: enrichment enters condensation as enr^2 and activation as enr, while precipitation is first-order in phosphate, so a concentrated pore tips phosphate's fate toward the reactive route.

findings.statement: The SAME real og-03 thermophoretic pore that lifts a dilute carbon feed across the ignition threshold (species-agnostic Soret + convection trap) co-concentrates phosphate: at the pore's enrichment the P reactive-availability is positive and the enrichment exceeds the carbon co-concentration floor (~10×). C and P co-concentrate in one pore regime — reported as an overlap boundary, not a fitted target.

evidence.observed: og-03 pore enrichment >> 10× carbon co-concentration floor; P reactive-availability positive at that enrichment

findings.explanation: The thermophoretic trap enrichment depends on the Soret coefficient and pore geometry, not on the solute identity, so the pore that concentrates carbon concentrates phosphate; coupling it to the P-speciation network shows reactive P becomes available in the same regime.

findings.statement: The feature ablation is decisive — an open pore / no thermal gradient (enrichment = 1) collapses reactive-P availability: net availability goes negative and ~96% of phosphorus precipitates to the mineral sink. Phosphate precipitates/adsorbs before it is chemically useful unless the pore concentrates it first.

evidence.observed: favorable net ~+1.8e-6 (6% precipitated) vs open-pore net < 0 (~96% precipitated)

findings.explanation: Without enrichment the condensation/activation fluxes (enr-gated) fall below the first-order precipitation loss, so phosphate drains into mineral-bound P — the phosphorus bottleneck made explicit.

findings.statement: A 16×16 sweep over (phosphate source × pore/thermal enrichment) maps where reactive P is available, not just that it is at one point. Reactive-P availability is bounded by the net-availability threshold (production = loss) on the enrichment axis; the PASS region is where that threshold is crossed AND the enrichment co-concentrates carbon (right of the ~10× carbon floor). Below the threshold phosphate precipitates before it is useful.

evidence.observed: reactive-P pool ranges ~0 to ~1 mM across the (source × enrichment) plane (~94% of supply, ~94 µM, at the favorable 1e-4 M point); availability bounded by net=0 and the carbon co-concentration floor

findings.explanation: 16×16 sweep of the real libRoadRunner composite reduced to the settled reactive-P pool, net availability and precipitated fraction; rendered as the reactive-P availability phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_phosphorus_availability_grid.py.

studies.claim: A real libRoadRunner P-speciation network coupled to the og-03 thermal pore shows reactive phosphorus becomes available only in a bounded (phosphate source × pore enrichment) window where condensation + activation outrun the precipitation/adsorption sink; the same pore enrichment that concentrates carbon co-concentrates P, and without the gradient phosphate precipitates before it is useful — phosphorus is a localization-gated bottleneck, not a free resource.

biological_validation.basis: Reactive-P availability beats loss in the favorable pore and co-concentrates with carbon, with the open-pore ablation collapsing it.

explanatory_gain.basis: The real speciation network shows WHY P is a harder bottleneck — precipitation is first-order while the useful routes are enrichment-gated, so P needs localization that C needs less.

derived.insight: In the favorable thermal-gradient pore, reactive-P formation outpaces the precipitation/adsorption loss — net reactive-P availability settles positive (~+1.8e-6 mol/s) and reactive P accumulates to ~94% of the supplied phosphorus while only ~6% precipitates. A bounded local window exists where reactive P is produced faster than it is lost.

studies.name: og-energy-proto-energetics
studies.title: The Energy Currency
studies.question: Can a primitive system capture environmental (geochemical) free energy into a transferable chemical currency — charged by an exergonic drive, spent on endergonic work, lost to hydrolysis — before any modern-style ion pumping, and what fraction of the geochemical free energy becomes stored usable work?
proposed_mechanisms: energetics: pre-ATP energy currency (thioesters / acyl phosphates / polyphosphates)
proposed_models_methods: free-energy ledger (input = useful work + stored + dissipated) as a conservation invariant
charge / discharge / hydrolysis kinetics of a transferable carrier pool
phase map over (geochemical free-energy drive x coupling efficiency)

conditions.name: reproducibility
conditions.expr: solver and db and seed and scenario recorded

contract.note: bigraph-schema typed ports (_type/_units/bounds) + a free-energy-accounting conservation predicate; the proto_energetics composite declares a ProcessContract matching this face (audited via the workbench §Contract panel). Free-energy accounting (input = work + stored + dissipated) is the stage's conservation invariant, held to machine precision.

resolved_uncertainties: A primitive system can capture environmental free energy into a transferable currency, and the captured fraction is bounded and measurable (~47% at the favourable point).
Capture requires both a coupling chemistry and a drive that clears the carrier bond (both ablations collapse).
remaining_uncertainties: Which primitive coupling chemistry (thioester vs acyl-phosphate vs polyphosphate vs reduced-metal) best supports synthesis / transport / maintenance under realistic drives.
How the stored-work fraction trades against turnover when the endergonic load spectrum (synthesis / transport / maintenance) is resolved.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Sweep the carrier type and the load spectrum to rank the primitive coupling chemistries for synthesis / transport / maintenance.

findings.statement: An exergonic geochemical drive coupled to a pre-ATP thioester-class carrier builds and MAINTAINS a transferable energy currency under continuous endergonic load — the charged pool fills from empty and settles at ~39% of capacity, a spendable store held against discharge and hydrolysis. This is energetic bookkeeping (a carrier charged and spent), not a favourable reaction direction.

evidence.observed: charged fraction 0.00 -> 0.39 and held under load

findings.explanation: ProtoEnergyCurrencyProcess charges the carrier at the coupling efficiency when the drive ΔG clears the carrier bond, discharges it to endergonic work under load, and bleeds it by first-order hydrolysis; the steady charge is the balance of charging against the two drains.

findings.statement: Accounting the free energy by DESTINATION (a conserved ledger: input = useful work + stored + dissipated) shows ~47% of the tapped geochemical free energy is captured as transferable usable work at the favourable operating point, the remaining ~53% dissipated (uncoupled drive, discharge inefficiency, hydrolysis). Capture is not assumed — it is measured, bounded, and falls off smoothly as the coupling efficiency or the drive margin over the carrier bond declines.

evidence.observed: stored-work fraction 0.47 of input free energy; ledger residual ~1e-16 kJ/L

findings.explanation: The currency process emits the full ledger (input / work / stored / dissipated); the stored-work fraction is (work + stored)/input. Charging draws bond/efficiency of input per charged mole (the uncoupled remainder dissipated), so the captured fraction is bounded above by the coupling efficiency and reduced further by discharge loss and hydrolysis — rendered as the energy-provenance panel (Mechanism) and the capture landscape (Decision).

findings.statement: The currency collapses under either ablation — no coupling (efficiency -> 0) OR a drive ΔG below the carrier's high-energy bond — so capturing environmental free energy into a transferable store requires BOTH a coupling chemistry and a drive strong enough to clear the bond. The drive axis has a real thermodynamic gate, not merely a rate dependence; the Decision phase map is the bounded region where both conditions hold.

evidence.observed: favourable charged fraction 0.39 vs no-coupling 0.00 / no-drive 0.00

findings.explanation: A carrier can only be charged when the drive ΔG exceeds the bond energy (a weak drive cannot charge a high-energy carrier) and the coupling actually transfers it; below either threshold no store builds, so the viable region is bounded on both axes.

studies.claim: A pre-ATP thioester-class carrier coupled to an exergonic geochemical drive maintains a transferable energy currency under endergonic load (charged fraction ~0.39) and captures ~47% of the tapped geochemical free energy as stored usable work; removing the coupling or starving the drive below the carrier bond collapses the currency — capturing free energy into a transferable store is an explicit, bounded, falsifiable transition, not a favourable reaction direction.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the pre-ATP energy-currency concept (Buckel & Thauer 2013; Lane & Martin 2010) — an exergonic drive captured into a transferable carrier that does endergonic work, with capture gated by the drive-vs-bond thermodynamics.

explanatory_gain.basis: The free-energy ledger explains both WHERE a currency is viable (the bounded drive x efficiency region) and HOW MUCH geochemical free energy becomes usable work (the stored-work fraction), from explicit bookkeeping rather than assumption.

derived.insight: An exergonic geochemical drive coupled to a pre-ATP thioester-class carrier builds and MAINTAINS a transferable energy currency under continuous endergonic load — the charged pool fills from empty and settles at ~39% of capacity, a spendable store held against discharge and hydrolysis. This is energetic bookkeeping (a carrier charged and spent), not a favourable reaction direction.

studies.name: og-growth-division
studies.title: Growth and Division
studies.question: Does an internal autocatalytic/metabolic chemistry change a compartment's PHYSICAL fate — accumulating product, generating osmotic pressure, drawing in solvent, expanding, and forcing division — and under what permeability regime does it divide rather than lyse or starve?
proposed_mechanisms: H+: metabolism changes the compartment's physical fate (osmotic growth → division)
osmotic pressure as a physical selection mechanism (no abstract fitness score)
proposed_models_methods: custom coarse-grained osmotic membrane kinetics (van 't Hoff + solubility-diffusion permeability)
parameter sweep over (throughput × permeability) → decision surface

conditions.name: osmotic_coupling_directionality
conditions.expr: osmotic_pressure >= 0 and solvent influx follows the osmotic gradient (dV/dt = Lp*A*Pi)

conditions.name: reproducibility
conditions.expr: solver and db and seed and scenario recorded

contract.note: bigraph-schema typed ports (_type/_units/bounds) + conservation predicates; the composite built for this study declares a ProcessContract matching this face (audited via the workbench §Contract panel). Division halves volume and contents exactly, so mass is conserved to machine precision across the growth/division cycle.

resolved_uncertainties: Internal autocatalytic chemistry can change a compartment's physical fate — product accumulation → osmotic pressure → solvent influx → growth → division, with no abstract fitness score.
Whether autocatalysis produces division rather than lysis or starvation is set by membrane permeability against throughput — a bounded viable band exists between the two failure modes.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether chemically better-organized compartments outcompete through growth alone when a population of dividing compartments shares a resource pool.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Run a population of dividing compartments on a shared resource field; test whether a higher-throughput (chemically better-organized) lineage outgrows and displaces the others through division rate alone.

findings.statement: In the matched regime the internal autocatalytic source accumulates product, the osmotic pressure it generates draws solvent in, and the compartment grows to the division threshold and divides repeatedly (8 divisions over the run) — the chemistry changes the compartment's physical fate, a physical selection mechanism without an abstract fitness score.

evidence.observed: 8 divisions; outcome = divide; net growth sawtooth driven by osmotic pressure ~1.2e5 Pa

findings.explanation: OsmoticGrowthDivisionProcess integrates dN/dt (autocatalytic source − leak), Pi = R·T·c_in (van 't Hoff), dV/dt = Lp·A·Pi (solvent influx), and halves V and N at the division threshold.

findings.statement: Sustained net growth leading to division occupies a BOUNDED band of (network throughput × membrane permeability) — about a quarter of the swept grid — flanked by starvation where the membrane is too permeable (the product leaks out so the osmotic pressure never builds and nothing grows) and by lysis where it is too impermeable (the product is trapped, the pressure spikes past the burst tension and the membrane ruptures). Permeability, not throughput alone, decides whether autocatalysis produces a dividing protocell.

evidence.observed: matched → 8 divisions; too permeable (P=1e-5 m/s) → 0 divisions, net growth ~1.00 (starve); too impermeable (P=1e-10 m/s, high throughput) → lysed at ~1.5e5 Pa

findings.explanation: The equilibrium internal concentration scales as throughput / (permeability · area); below a floor the osmotic drive cannot grow the compartment (starve), above a ceiling it exceeds the burst pressure before division can relieve it (lyse).

findings.statement: The growth is driven by the chemistry, not by the compartment physics alone — with the autocatalytic source ablated (zero throughput) the compartment neither grows nor divides, while mass stays conserved across the whole cycle (residual ~4e-32 mol).

evidence.observed: ablation (throughput ~0) → 0 divisions, net growth ~1.04; favorable → 8 divisions; mass residual ~4e-32 mol

findings.explanation: With no source the only osmolyte is the small seed; the osmotic pressure stays far below the drive needed to reach the division threshold, and division halving conserves mass exactly.

studies.claim: A protocell's chemistry can change its physical fate. An internal autocatalytic/metabolic source makes an osmolyte; its accumulation raises the internal osmotic pressure (van 't Hoff), that pressure draws solvent across the semi-permeable membrane, the compartment expands, and at a size threshold it divides — a physical selection mechanism with no abstract fitness score. Whether this produces division rather than lysis or starvation is set by the membrane permeability against the network throughput — there is a bounded viable band in which net growth leads to repeated division, flanked by starvation (too permeable — the product leaks before the osmotic pressure can build) and lysis (too impermeable — the pressure bursts the membrane). Mass is conserved to machine precision across growth and division.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the expectation that internal product accumulation generates osmotic pressure that grows and divides a vesicle compartment (Jordan 2019 feasibility; osmotic-growth vesicle division), driven by an autocatalytic rTCA-style source (Muchowska 2019).

explanatory_gain.basis: Explains WHY autocatalysis produces division rather than lysis or starvation — the osmotic drive must be retained enough to grow yet leaked/divided fast enough to stay below the burst pressure, giving a bounded viable band in (throughput × permeability).

derived.insight: In the matched regime the internal autocatalytic source accumulates product, the osmotic pressure it generates draws solvent in, and the compartment grows to the division threshold and divides repeatedly (8 divisions over the run) — the chemistry changes the compartment's physical fate, a physical selection mechanism without an abstract fitness score.

studies.name: og-01-cal-electrochemistry
studies.title: The Vent Wall as a Galvanic Cell: Which Limitation Stops Carbon Fixation, and Do the Model Classes Agree?
studies.question: Model Upgrade plan, Phase 2 (electrochemical carbon fixation). og-01 drives CO2 reduction with a scalar gradient_efficiency and a Michaelis drive in the proton-motive force, so it can say WHETHER fixation runs but not WHY it stops. Treating the vent wall as an electrical circuit instead — fluid redox state -> Nernst electrode potentials -> Butler-Volmer overpotentials -> current density -> surface rates — which limitation (thermodynamic, electrical, catalytic, transport) binds where over (vent pH x dissolved H2 x mineral conductivity x Ni/Fe), and do the empirical and the electrochemical model classes on the new carbon_fixation face agree on that label in the region both call favorable?
proposed_mechanisms: A: empirical gated kinetics (og-01) with the gradient efficiency derived from the wall circuit
B: the wall as a galvanic cell — Nernst potentials, Butler-Volmer kinetics, ohmic mineral + ionic path, faradaic split
C: adsorbate microkinetics with site coverage and passivation (deferred; pixi)
proposed_models_methods: carbon_fixation face with the model class as a categorical sweep axis
Nernst + Butler-Volmer galvanic-cell solve (Brent) per tick; Koutecky-Levich transport limits; Bruggeman ionic path
Loss-fraction partition of the fresh-fluid emf -> limitation label per point; cross-class agreement + confusion
Charge + electron ledger (Kirchhoff residual, faradaic efficiency <= 1, current-voltage residual)

conditions.name: loss_partition
conditions.expr: loss_thermodynamic + loss_electrical + loss_catalytic + loss_transport == 1 while current flows (butler_volmer)

contract.note: Ports are canonical vg_* fields (viva_genesis/schemas.py PORT_TO_CANONICAL); every carbon_fixation class is face-checked at build (models.assert_face).

resolved_uncertainties: gradient_efficiency can be derived from the wall's circuit; an insulating wall (< 1e-6 S/m) collapses it as a consequence.
The charge + electron ledger closes for both classes; faradaic efficiency is bounded.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the cell is really activation-limited at Lost-City-like conditions (depends on the exchange currents; the per-condition Altair data would pin them).
Whether site coverage and passivation (microkinetic class) move the catalytic label toward transport at high current.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Run the microkinetic class under pixi; attach the Altair-2025 time courses and fit the exchange currents; re-evaluate the agreement gate with three classes.
Re-run og-01's gates with model_carbon_fixation = butler_volmer as the default class and report the parameter-robust vs structure-sensitive regions of its phase map.

findings.statement: Every one of the 375 grid points carries a limitation label in both runnable classes (coverage 1.00; 0 failed runs). Butler-Volmer: catalytic 226, electrical 149, transport 0, thermodynamic 0. Empirical: transport 147, catalytic 117, electrical 108, thermodynamic 3.

evidence.observed: label coverage 1.00 (empirical), 1.00 (butler_volmer); 0/750 failed points

findings.explanation: The Butler-Volmer class partitions the fresh-fluid emf into product back-pressure (thermodynamic), ohmic drop (electrical), activation overpotential (catalytic) and concentration overpotential (transport) — four fractions that sum to one while current flows — and takes the largest (a cathode sending most electrons to H2 is catalytic / selectivity-limited). The empirical class publishes the headroom of each of its multiplicative gates (1 - feasible, 1 - drive(pmf), 1 - catalyst x Ni gain, 1 - availability). Artifact: artifacts/electrochemistry_mechanism_map.json.

findings.statement: The pre-registered failure-mode-attributed gate fails: on the 78 points both classes call favorable the labels agree on 37 (0.47); overall 168/375 (0.45). The confusion is systematic, not noise — every Butler-Volmer favorable point is catalytic (93/93), while the empirical class calls 47 of its favorable points electrical and 28 transport. Agreement is high only where the physics is unambiguous: 0.81 at 1e-9 S/m (both: electrical) and 0.67-0.68 at H2 >= 1.4e-4 M; it collapses to 0.01 at 1 uM H2, where the empirical Michaelis constant (1e-4 M) declares transport limitation that the cell never reaches (the limiting current stays above the activation-limited current at these exchange currents).

evidence.observed: label agreement 0.474 on 78 favorable-both points (gate >= 0.8); 0.448 overall; favorability structure agreement 0.65

findings.explanation: The empirical rate law's drive(pmf) = pmf / (pmf + 0.08 V) lumps the delivered gradient (electrical) and the electrode kinetics (catalytic) into one saturating term, so its "electrical" headroom in the favorable region is what the Butler-Volmer class resolves as activation overpotential. Paired class differences on identical points: loss_transport d = 1.77, loss_thermodynamic d = 0.68 (discriminating); loss_electrical, loss_catalytic and gradient_efficiency |d| < 0.5 (not discriminating). decision_discipline flags the attribution as structure-sensitive.

findings.statement: Under explicit electrochemistry the alkaline-vent cell is catalytically (activation) limited everywhere the wall conducts: at the nominal point (pH 9.5 | 6.0, 5 mM H2, 2 mM CO2, 100 C, 1e-3 S/m, Ni3Fe) the anode + cathode activation overpotentials take 0.996 of the 0.49 V fresh-fluid emf, the ohmic drop 0.002 and transport 0.001, at j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2 with faradaic efficiency 0.92 to carbon. Throughput rises only ~40x across the whole (pH x H2) plane (74 mV per pH unit, (RT/2F) ln10 per decade of H2) because the current scales with the exchange current, not the driving force. The electrical regime appears below ~1e-6 S/m (ohmic drop > activation), where the circuit-derived gradient efficiency is 0.01-0.42.

evidence.observed: nominal losses: catalytic 0.996, electrical 0.002, transport 0.001, thermodynamic 0.0; j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2; FE 0.92; gradient_efficiency 0.01 / 0.42 / 0.98 / 1.00 at 1e-9 / 1e-7 / 1e-5 / 1e-3 S/m

findings.explanation: Exchange currents calibrated to the Altair-2025 current window (j0_co2 1e-5, j0_h2 5e-5, j0_her 2.5e-6 A/m^2 at Ni3Fe, 100 C) are small, so the Butler-Volmer branches need ~0.2-0.3 V each to carry 1e-3 A/m^2; the mineral + ionic path drops microvolts unless the wall is an insulator. This is a prediction under the calibration, not a measurement: the per-condition Altair currents are not yet attached.

findings.statement: The Butler-Volmer class's settled current density lies inside the Altair-2025 window (1e-5 .. 1e-2 A/m^2, i.e. ~10 nA .. 10 uA on the cm^2-scale interface) at the canonical operating point and on 79.7% of the grid (range 1.4e-7 .. 3.0e-3 A/m^2; the points below the window are the insulating walls). Selectivity to carbon products stays 0.76-1.00.

evidence.observed: canonical j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2; grid fraction in window 0.797; FE 0.76-1.00

findings.explanation: Reproduction-tier check against the calibration window (vg-data electrochemical_interface.observations.cell_current_density); the window is the dossier summary, not a per-condition fit.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: the ChargeLedgerProcess closes on all 750 mechanism-map runs and on the 120-tick canonical run — Kirchhoff residual |anode - (carbon + H2 evolution)| / anode <= 1.7e-13 (0.0 for the empirical class), faradaic efficiency never above 1 (max 1 + 1e-13), circuit residual <= 8.5e-9. The ledger caught a real bookkeeping gap during the build (on insulating walls the trace ocean-side H2 oxidising at the cathode co-supplies electrons), which is now counted explicitly.

evidence.observed: charge residual <= 1.7e-13; FE max 1.0000000000001; iv residual <= 8.5e-9; 0/750 failed

studies.claim: Explicit electrochemistry is feasible, calibrated and ledger-exact, and it changes the answer to "why does fixation stop": under the Butler-Volmer class the alkaline-vent cell is activation-limited everywhere the wall conducts — the catalyst, not the gradient, binds — and the Tutolo-style collapse is an electrical regime below ~1e-6 S/m that both classes recover. The empirical class cannot make that attribution because its one Michaelis drive term lumps electrical and catalytic limitation and its substrate Michaelis constant invents a transport limit the cell physics does not have. The failure-mode label is therefore structure-sensitive (agreement 0.47 < 0.8): a negative result on the gate and the Phase-2 mechanism map the plan asked for, recorded as a decision for the expert rather than hidden.

biological_validation.basis: Calibrated to a current window; the per-condition Altair currents and the microkinetic class are needed before the catalytic-limitation claim can be called validated.

explanatory_gain.basis: Separates electrical from catalytic limitation, derives the Tutolo collapse from conductivity, and shows the empirical rate law cannot attribute the limitation — a structural result the empirical class alone could not produce.

derived.insight: Every one of the 375 grid points carries a limitation label in both runnable classes (coverage 1.00; 0 failed runs). Butler-Volmer: catalytic 226, electrical 149, transport 0, thermodynamic 0. Empirical: transport 147, catalytic 117, electrical 108, thermodynamic 3.

studies.name: og-02-alt-reaction-universe
studies.title: The Open Network: Do Autocatalytic Motifs Emerge From Rule-Generated Chemistry, Beyond Chance?
studies.question: Model Upgrade plan, Phase 3. og-02 showed a hand-curated rTCA fragment persists and self-amplifies under flow — but its autocatalytic turn (OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate) was written into the network. If the network is instead GENERATED from a Wolos-2020-style rule set over C1-C3 feedstock with real eQuilibrator thermodynamics, catalyst limits and degradation, and fed the Phase-1 posterior vent state, do persistent autocatalytic subnetworks appear at all, are they more frequent than in matched null networks, and how does the curated rTCA class compare when all three are graded by one post-hoc detector and one element / free-energy ledger?
proposed_mechanisms: E: protometabolic network formation (rule-generated, not curated)
D: surface chemistry as catalyst classes with finite site pools
proposed_models_methods: Rule-based network generation (Wolos 2020 style) over linear C/H/O skeletons
eQuilibrator component-contribution dG' + group-additivity fallback; detailed-balance kinetics
libRoadRunner CVODE integration; post-hoc autocatalytic-core enumeration (Blokhuis 2020)
Element + free-energy ledger; flux-control summation theorem; tolerance / stiffness check

conditions.name: motifs_post_hoc
conditions.expr: no rule names a cycle; motifs are detected by viva_genesis.protometabolism.motifs on every class

contract.note: The proto_metabolism face (viva_genesis/models.py) is honoured by all three classes (assert_face); ports are canonical vg_* fields (schemas.PORT_TO_CANONICAL).

resolved_uncertainties: og-02's autocatalytic gain was imposed by the lumped reaction; a rule-generated network with real dG' reproduces its reductive branch but not its motif.
The C <= 4 C/H/O rule set contains exactly one closable autocatalytic cycle (formose), and it is enriched over matched nulls when fed formaldehyde.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether co-localization (Phase 4) raises formate / glycolaldehyde activities enough to make the reductive-carboxylation routes downhill.
Whether N/P-bearing rules (og-res-N / og-res-P folded in) or branched skeletons (citrate) open rTCA-type cycles.
How the ignition region moves under the rate-constant priors (Sobol on the package).

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Propagate the reaction_universe priors (LHS over the 15 free rate constants) through both arms and report the posterior ignition fraction per class; add branched C5/C6 skeletons.
Feed the Phase-4 co-localized concentrations into the universe and ask whether the C1 -> C2 bottleneck opens (the flagship chain).

findings.statement: At the Phase-1 posterior feed the rule-generated universe (121 species, 413 reversible reactions, C <= 4) sustains 14 persistent species and a net CO2 fixation of 2.2e-5 mol/s but contains NO persistent autocatalytic motif (0 flux-carrying simple cycles with gain > 1); all 24 matched nulls also contain 0. The rTCA reductive branch pyruvate -> OAA -> malate -> succinate appears from the rules at 5e-8 / 9e-8 / 8e-9 M — three orders below og-02's curated 2 mM OAA — because pyruvate carboxylation at 1.4 mM CO2 sits at its equilibrium (dG'0 = -1.1 kJ/mol -> [OAA]/[pyruvate] = K [CO2] = 2e-3) rather than being driven irreversibly.

evidence.observed: universe 0 motifs, 14 persistent species, malate 8.8e-8 M; nulls 0/24; p = 1.0

findings.explanation: Every C-C bond-forming route is uphill at vent concentrations: reductive carboxylation of formate / acetate (+7.7 / +30.6 kJ/mol standard, +50 kJ/mol at the actual mM / 10 mM activities) and the aldehyde route (formate + H2 -> formaldehyde, +28 kJ/mol; [CH2O]eq = 3e-10 M). The universe is dissipative (0.88 W/L) but its flux is C1 reduction and pyruvate decay. Artifact: artifacts/motif_enrichment.json (arm phase1_feed).

findings.statement: With 10 mM formaldehyde added to the same feed, exactly one persistent autocatalytic motif emerges from the rules and is recovered post hoc: glycolaldehyde + CH2O -> glyceraldehyde -> dihydroxyacetone (+ CH2O) -> erythrulose -> erythrose -> 2 glycolaldehyde — the formose cycle (stoichiometric gain 2, dynamic gain 3.1 > 1, core of 5 species, 49 persistent species). 0 of 24 degree-preserving, (C,O)-matched null networks contain any motif: empirical p = 0.040 (1/25). The 6x6 ignition map (0.1-30 mM CH2O x 0.001-0.2/s washout; 3 nulls per cell, all 0) shows the motif only at formaldehyde >= 9.6 mM with washout >= 0.024/s, or 30 mM with washout >= 0.008/s (dynamic gain up to 18): at longer residence times the H2 reduction of formaldehyde and glycolaldehyde (k_reduce [H2] = 0.1/s) outruns the aldol propagation, and the gain falls below 1 again at 0.2/s where washout wins.

evidence.observed: universe 1 motif (gain 2, dynamic 3.1); nulls 0/24; p = 0.040; curated 1 motif (imposed)

findings.explanation: No rule names a cycle; the detector enumerates flux-carrying simple cycles with stoichiometric gain > 1 (Blokhuis 2020 type-I cores) from the doubling edges, identically for every class. The formose cycle closes through the retro-aldol of erythrose (the only doubling edge the chemistry provides at C <= 4). Artifact: artifacts/motif_enrichment.json (arm formose_feed, ignition_map).

findings.statement: Graded by the same detector, og-02's curated rTCA class shows one motif — the self-loop OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate — with dynamic gain 2.99, exactly its declared k_rtca [CO2] / k_wash, so the og-02 "autocatalytic gain" was a property written into the network, not an emergent one. The element ledger over its SBML finds the lumped turn creates 4 C, 8 H and 3 O per turn (6 C in, 10 C out), so og-02's net carbon throughput (6e-4 mol/s) counts carbon that was never fed. The curated class remains the fastest and richest in product, and the least conserving, of the three.

evidence.observed: element residual C 4 / H 8 / O 3 (max 8); detector gain 2.99 = declared 2.99

findings.explanation: og-02's finding og02-autocatalysis already said the motif was a curated lumped reaction; this study makes the consequence quantitative and machine-witnessed. The curated result keeps its PASS in og-02 (its gates do not include conservation) but is reclassed here as the imposed class.

The (C,O)-matched nulls fail the element ledger on hydrogen (residual 8-12) by construction.

evidence.observed: element 0; carbon 2.8e-6; dissipation_min >= 0; FCC summation 3.3e-3; tol sensitivity 7.0e-6

findings.explanation: Kinetics use the exergonic-direction class rate (k_down = k0, k_up = k0 exp(-|dG'0|/RT)), so detailed balance holds exactly and no rate exceeds a catalyst's turnover; the dissipation witness is therefore a real second-law check, not an identity.
